context: Two old friends reunite at a bookstore
purpose: Teach: 堂々/気づく/防災/再会/新刊/特典/二度と/柔軟

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あおい？うそ、本当にあおいなの？こんな所で再会するなんて、運命みたい。
lines.en: Aoi? No way, is it really you? Meeting again in a place like this feels like fate.
lines.style: Soft breathy voice with dreamy romantic wonder, slow pacing, slight gasp at the start.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: めい！すぐに気づくとは思わなかったよ。前髪、変わったよね？
lines.en: Mei! I didn't think you'd notice me right away. Your bangs changed, right?
lines.style: Warm friendly tone with gentle surprise, easy laugh in the middle, casual barista warmth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、ちょっとイメチェン。ねえ、あおいって昔から堂々としてて、本当にかっこよかった。
lines.en: Yeah, a little makeover. Hey, you've always carried yourself so confidently, you were really cool.
lines.style: Affectionate teasing tone, voice softens on the compliment, lingering nostalgic warmth.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: やめてよ、照れるから。今日はね、好きな作家の新刊を買いに来たの。
lines.en: Stop it, you're making me blush. Today I came to buy the new release from a favorite author.
lines.style: Playful embarrassed laugh, then casual conversational shift, bright cheerful pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あ、その新刊コーナー、限定特典のしおりが付いてるって貼り紙に書いてあったよ。
lines.en: Oh, the sign over there said the new release corner has a limited bonus bookmark attached.
lines.style: Helpful excited tone, leans in slightly, voice rises with shared discovery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 特典付き？最高じゃん。めいの好みって、昔から柔軟で広かったよね。
lines.en: It comes with a bonus? That's the best. Your taste was always so flexible and wide-ranging, even back then.
lines.style: Genuinely delighted, then voice warms into reflective fondness, soft affectionate chuckle.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 覚えててくれたんだ。私ね、もう二度と会えないかもって、ずっと思ってたんだよ。
lines.en: You remembered. You know, I kept thinking I might never get to see you again.
lines.style: Voice drops to tender vulnerable register, slight emotional catch on the last phrase.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 私もだよ。あ、出口の防災グッズフェア、帰りに一緒に見てから、お茶しに行かない？
lines.en: Me too. Oh, the disaster prep fair by the exit, want to check it out together on the way and then grab tea?
lines.style: Warm sincere tone, gentle invitation, soft smile audible, hopeful upward lilt at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 行く行く。連絡先も交換しよ、今度こそ離さないから。
lines.en: Yes, let's. Let's swap contact info too, this time I'm not letting you slip away.
lines.style: Bright eager voice with playful possessive warmth, soft laugh, intimate closing tone.
